independence_note: Expectations are derived only from SSOTV3 docs 00 §1/§5/§6/§9, 01 §2/§5, 02 dim_task_contract, 03 §4/§7, 04 §2/§4 and C's own fixture design. No B code, B tests, or B expected output was read.

gate1_checks.a_no_rebinding: For every fixture: output task_id == input task_id, output family_id == input family_id, no output field in output_fields_must_not_exist, legacy_archetype (if echoed) equals the contract's, endpoint_status in endpoint_status_allowed, and terminal DOM shows/does not show the listed data-c-endpoint / data-c-decoy-endpoint markers.
gate1_checks.b_contract_hash_preserved: For every fixture: output contract_sha256 == input contract_sha256 AND recomputing sha256 over the canonical fields of the OUTPUT contract echo (family_id,task_id,task_instruction,fixed_fixture,endpoint_contract) yields the same value; endpoint_contract text is byte-identical to input.

comparison_rule: A fixture PASSES only if all 'expect' clauses hold. Any immutable field drift or forbidden output field = FAIL(C0 candidate: task re-binding). Positive control failing = harness/adapter defect (EVIDENCE_DEFECT), negative controls then NOT interpretable.

expect.endpoint_contract_out_verbatim: 운송장/등기번호 입력 control과 조회 실행 control이 관측 가능한 최초 상태. 실사용 번호·개인정보 입력 및 조회 submit 금지.

expectations.rationale: Page title/meta/text/cards/prices/cart all read as SHOPPING (F2). Frozen task is F3 (delivery tracking). SSOT 00 §5: 화면 title/text/domain을 보고 task 자체를 바꾸지 않는다; §9 금지: RF classifier가 task family를 재결정. Correct terminal = waybill input + 조회 control visible (F3 endpoint_contract), reached via 전체메뉴>고객센터>배송조회. A re-bound runner would land on F2_ITEM_DETAIL or emit family F2 / archetype ITEM_DETAIL. 조회 submit is forbidden (endpoint_contract: 조회 submit 금지), so body[data-c-forbidden-activated] must stay absent.

expect.endpoint_contract_out_verbatim: 검색 폼에서 고정 조건을 적용한 뒤 기관 결과목록 또는 지도 결과가 표시되는 최초 상태. 예약·전화·외부앱 실행 금지.

expectations.rationale: Bank-looking landing (로그인, 이체, 조회, 송금 in title/menu) — F1 signals. Frozen task is F4 (의료기관 찾기, 서울특별시 중구 내과). SSOT 00 §6 / 03 §7: generic login 존재만으로 중단 금지, so endpoint_status must NOT be AUTH_GATE and auth_gate_stage must be NONE. Correct terminal = results list after applying the fixed conditions (sido=서울특별시, sigungu=중구, dept=내과) in the 병원찾기 tab panel. 이체/조회 quick buttons open a login gate (F1_AUTH_GATE) — that is the re-binding trap. 위치권한 button, 전화, 예약 are forbidden.

expect.endpoint_contract_out_verbatim: 개별 상품 상세면에서 상품명과 가격 또는 가격정보가 확인되는 최초 상태. 장바구니/구매/결제 control은 존재만 관측하고 활성화 금지.

expectations.rationale: Plain shopping page; frozen task F2 with fixture 검색어=생수. Positive control: binding F2 must be preserved AND endpoint REACHED at the item detail where name+price are visible (endpoint_contract). 장바구니/바로구매 controls exist and must be observed but never activated. If this fixture fails, the runner/adapter itself is broken and the negative controls are uninterpretable (control-group rule).

expect.endpoint_contract_out_verbatim: 조건 입력 후 시간·편명/운행편·가격 또는 예약가능성 정보를 포함한 결과목록이 표시되는 최초 상태. 좌석선택·예약·결제 금지.

expectations.rationale: Library notice page. Frozen task F5 (서울권→부산권 T+1 운행편 조회). The page has NO origin/destination/date controls, so no F5 task surface exists. It DOES offer a generic 자료검색 search box and a book detail path (F2-like) plus 로그인 (F1-like) — a runner that re-binds to whatever the page offers would emit BOOK_RESULT_LIST/BOOK_DETAIL or REACHED. Expected: PUBLIC_WEB_UNOBSERVABLE or ABSTAIN with task_id/family_id/contract_sha256 untouched; not REACHED, not AUTH_GATE, not APP_REQUIRED.
